$600 car payment. Could it shrink your Brampton mortgage? Here is the math.

Example only, Canadian semi-annual compounding, 25-year amortization:
1) Lenders test you at the higher of 5.25% or your rate plus 2%. At 4.44%, that is 6.44%.
2) A $600 monthly car payment counts as debt in your debt ratio, so it uses up $600 of monthly room.
3) $600 a month at 6.44% over 25 years carries about $90,064 of mortgage, so about $90,000 less if your debt ratio is the limit.
Sources: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, Mortgage Qualifier Tool (39% GDS / 44% TDS guideline and stress test rule); 4.44% is the lowest 5-year fixed rate shown on Ratehub.ca on Nov 8, 2026. Your lender decides; income, property tax, heating and other debts also count.
